reason: The one thing I need to know, the fee per transaction and when the money lands, isn't on the page, just a promise to show me later. Half my summer guests are tourists who won't come back, and I already message regulars for free on Instagram and WhatsApp, so the loyalty side isn't worth paying for until I see the payment terms.
objection: If the Keepz fee is higher than my terminal or payouts take days, the QR payments cost me money on every bill, and 39 lari a month for messaging I already do for free doesn't make up for that.
would_change_my_mind: The exact Keepz fee written down up front, the same as or below my card terminal, with next-day payout. Then I'd try the free founding months, mostly for the Google and Tripadvisor review invites from tourists.
